title: Logo Family Tree
slide_intent: Organize signature variants by the entity they identify. A reader can choose the correct level before choosing an orientation.
strategic_value: The lab can distinguish its own identity, its programs and its groups while retaining the same parent mark.
demonstration: Four ruled rows compare primary, tag, secondary and tertiary versions. The lower rows show Alliances and Advanced Network Architecture Group examples.
practical_value: Choose a level by the communication’s owner, then choose the descriptor position that fits the available width.

content_islands.name: Variant guidance
content_islands.spec: Explain the tiers in the left rail, with a short use-case note near the foot.

content_islands.name: Family matrix
content_islands.spec: Label four horizontal rows on a pale ground. Within each row align the available color lockups to compare the bare mark, stacked labels and labels set to the right.
